reasoning: No Hantavirus vaccine is in advanced US trials; the rare disease burden makes large efficacy studies difficult, and full FDA approval typically requires years of clinical data. Within ~20 months, emergence until approval is highly improbable. The market's 8.5% is thus overpriced.
evidence_points: No publicly known Phase 3 trial for a Hantavirus vaccine in the US as of early 2025
FDA vaccine approval typically takes 3+ years from Phase 3 start; animal-rule or accelerated pathways are rare and still require data
Commercial and public-health incentives are low due to sporadic, geographically limited cases
sources_consulted: General knowledge of hantavirus vaccine candidates (e.g., Hantavax not US-approved, US Army MVA candidate not in late-stage trials)
